_comment: Declares what distillation is allowed to read. The distinction is between RAW artifacts -- produced by the analysis run itself -- and DERIVED artifacts, which are somebody else's analysis OF the run. Feeding a derived artifact to the parser would launder their taxonomy into our vocabulary and destroy the free-discovery claim, so the boundary is a data file the pipeline enforces rather than a convention someone has to remember. Derived artifacts stay listed, because they are legitimate as an INDEPENDENT COMPARISON after v2 exists -- just never as input.

final_analysis.py.note: the script the run wrote and executed

mirrored_report.txt.note: the run's own report; median 16 KB. One file is 0 bytes, so 205 are usable.

transcript.json.note: the run's own reasoning and tool trace: 127 messages, ~63 assistant turns, ~42k chars of text. Content blocks are stored as Python reprs, so text must be extracted with a pattern rather than parsed as JSON. This is the only artifact that can distinguish a decision the run deliberated from one it took by default.

decisions_mapped.json.why_excluded: their decision extraction against a fixed 21-slot schema. Using it as input would import the taxonomy this project exists to avoid.
decisions_mapped.json.keep_for: independent comparison. 33% of what their own extractor found landed in unmapped_decisions (1,120 items over 207 runs), which is a ready-made inventory of what a fixed schema cannot hold.

sonnet_llmj.txt.why_excluded: an LLM-judge scoring rubric over the run (estimand_alignment, conclusion_discipline, ...). A quality judgement, not a run artifact.
sonnet_llmj.txt.keep_for: possible outcome-side comparison, never distillation input.

script.txt.note: R, Stata, SPSS, Stan or Python saved as .txt. 12 teams deposited none.

survey.txt.note: the Stage-3 questionnaire, field-structured. Absent for teams 30, 31, 32.

report.txt.note: the post-feedback manuscript. Absent for teams 19, 22.

soccer/human/distilled/*.why_excluded: v1 decision records. Unreproducible, and never a target, seed or validator for v2.

artifact_matrix._comment: Corrected from the plan's assumption. The two corpora are near mirror images: the AI runs are code-complete and were prose-blocked until the LFS fetch; the human teams are prose-complete and code-partial.

provenance.lfs_fetch: mirrored_report.txt, transcript.json, decisions_mapped.json and sonnet_llmj.txt were unfetched Git-LFS pointers in the distill-corpus volume. Pulled from origin https://github.com/amazon-science/agentic-forking-path.git, scoped to the sonnet-4-5 sample_soccer workspaces. final_analysis.py was already materialised, which is why the 207-script re-execution worked.
provenance.consequence: Before the fetch, 205 of 207 AI reports were absent, so exon-to-claim linking and silent-decision detection were impossible for 87% of the corpus. v1 nonetheless carries 4,165 code_refs citing mirrored_report.txt, made upstream where the files were real; none of them can be verified from this repo's prior state.
